parts.title: Learning a repair skill
questions: Do you usually try to fix small things yourself?
What tools are commonly used in your home?
Who taught you a practical skill when you were younger?
Do you prefer written instructions or a demonstration?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe something you learned to repair, or would like to learn to repair.
questions: Explain what skill or tool the repair requires.
Explain why learning the repair matters to you.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: Why do people replace some objects that could still be repaired?
What can schools contribute to learning practical skills?
How could a repair service be made easier to use?
When is replacing an object a better choice than repairing it?
